r10.ruleAText: R10 A: an unresolved Run or knowledge obligation retains the sole workspace; the existence of a backup never justifies early cleanup

pending.detail: the native runtime-store checkpoint still reports status "running"; an unresolved run retains the sole workspace (R10 A)

pendingReasons: cleanup requires verified completion or a separately approved migration whose restore has been proven (R10 A; spec-frozen obligations: pending-outline-publish, unknown-remote-result, sole-payload-in-workspace)
migration-approval missing or incomplete: an unapproved boundary change never moves R10 A
restore-proof missing or unverified: a proven restore (verified=true, sameOperationReadback=true) is required before the boundary may move

refusals.reason: pending obligations retain the sole workspace: unresolved-comet-run
